specs.Other Special Features of the Product: 10000mAh Qi2 Wireless Magsafe Powerbank, 15W Wireless, 22.5W Wired Output, Compatible with iPhone 12 & Above, Magsafe / Qi2 Fast Charging

features: Qi2 Certified & MagSafe Compatible: Charge faster and more efficiently, the latest Qi2 technology ensures perfect MagSafe alignment for your compatible devices.
Powerful 10,000mAh Capacity: Charge devices multiple times with a battery capacity of 10,000mAh, ensuring reliability on busy days.
Fast Charging: With a blazing 22.5W speed, this powerbank supports fast wireless charging via MagSafe, and faster wired charging Type-C & USB-A ports, ensuring quick and efficient power transfer.
Wide Compatibility: Compatible with Qi2 certified phones, MagSafe iPhones, Qi-enabled smartphones and all Type-C & USB-A powered devices (except laptops).
SafeCharge Technology: Multi-layer chipset protection offers safeguards against overcharging, overheating, and short circuits for secure operation.
Compact & Portable Design: AerosynQ Snap 2 is ideal for travel, commuting, or daily use, now enjoy MagSafe charging everywhere.
